stops.title: Asɔre Nkwa
stops.caption: Akontaa ɛnan a ɛho hia.
stops.speech: Asɔre Nkwa wɔ dashboard no atifi: asɔre mmaa, asafo no nyinaa, asɔrefoɔ a wɔahyɛ mu den, ne fekuo.

stops.title: Ɛhia Wo
stops.caption: Nneɛma a ɛretwɛn wo.
stops.speech: Saa afa yi kyerɛ deɛ ɛretwɛn: ɔpene a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ, asɔre mmaa a wonni ɔsɔfoɔ. Mia na kɔ hɔ.

stops.title: Nneyɛeɛ a Ɛbaa Nnansa
stops.caption: Hwan na ɔbaeɛ, ne berɛ bɛn.
stops.speech: Aseɛ hɔ, nneyɛeɛ a ɛbaa nnansa kyerɛ hwan na ɔkyerɛwee ne din ne berɛ bɛn, a wommue biribi foforɔ.
